description: This file provides cryptographic utility functions, including GUID and SHA-1 hash generation, ASN.1/DER encoding classes, and self-signed certificate generation using Node.js crypto module.

classes.name: DER
classes.description: A class providing static methods for ASN.1/DER encoding of various data types such as sequences, integers, object identifiers, nulls, sets, explicit context-dependent data, printable strings, bit strings, and dates.

methods.name: createGuid
methods.description: Generates a new GUID as a 32-character hexadecimal string using crypto.randomBytes.

methods.name: calculateSha1
methods.description: Calculates the SHA-1 hash of a given Buffer or string input.

methods.name: generateSelfSignedCertificate
methods.description: Creates a self-signed X.509 certificate with RSA key pair, valid for one year, encoded in PEM format.
